text:
incident-bot: P1 - NETWORK - HIGH_PACKET_LOSS detected in eu-west-1 transit path to TransitLink. Pager -> @oncall, @neteng

sara (oncall): acked. I'm oncall for eu-west, joining.

ajay (neteng): joining now. saw alerts ~10:04 UTC, spike in retransmits and RTT variance.

sara (oncall): customers reporting increased 5xx and slow responses for EU egress endpoints. Any immediate mitigation? :eyes:

ajay (neteng): initial scrub: packet loss looks upstream on TransitLink between our sfo->eu bgp handoff and provider; multiple AS path changes. Not local hardware.

diane (sre): impact seen on host-probe -> 15% loss to 8.8.8.8 via eu-west exit, service latency spikes to 600-1200ms for some requests. Configured alerting thresholds triggered.

kevin (edge): quick check - our peering to TransitLink in eu-west-1 shows flaps on the session:
```
show bgp summary
Neighbor        V AS MsgRcvd MsgSent   TblVer  InQ OutQ Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
10.200.12.1     4 64512 12345   12344        0    0  00:12:17  Active
```
(not stable)

ajay (neteng): running traceroute from egress host -> TransitLink nexthop:
```
traceroute to 198.51.100.1 (198.51.100.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms  0.3 ms  0.3 ms
 2  * * *
 3  203.0.113.5  22.8 ms  23.1 ms  23.0 ms  <-- loss + big jitter here
```

ajay (neteng): looks like intermittent blackhole / microflap inside TransitLink backbone (AS 64512). Multiple prefixes we originate are being withdrawn or moved.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigation options? Can we shift egress to BackupTransit via peering or announce more specific?

ajay (neteng): plan: 1) enable failover to BackupTransit via policy (local preference change) 2) prep secondary regional egress (eu-central) 3) ask TransitLink NOC for immediate confirmation and route re-advertise.

diane (sre): I'll start customer impact assessment and prepare a status update. Which customers are hitting eu-west endpoints?

kevin (edge): listing top affected services: embeddings-api-eu, user-auth-eu, webcdn-eu. Traffic percentages: embeddings-api-eu ~37% traffic uses eu-west egress.

pagerduty-bot: sara acknowledged the alert at 2026-03-15T10:06:12Z.

sara (oncall): implementing route-policy failover now. Will bump local-pref to prefer BackupTransit for affected prefixes. Running config change in staging route-rules then will apply to edge-routers.

ajay (neteng): sample config change (cisco-style) we pushed to the edge-router template: 
```
route-map PREFER-BACKUP permit 10
 set local-preference 200
! apply to prefixes 203.0.113.0/24 198.51.100.0/24
```

kevin (edge): applied to eu-west edge-01 (rolling): confirmed BGP session to BackupTransit established and prefixes now seen at BackupTransit.

diane (sre): evidence of effect: packet loss to 8.8.8.8 down from 15% -> 2% after failover for many probes. Some customers still on TransitLink path due to global routing.

ajay (neteng): opening ticket with TransitLink NOC: Ticket #TLK-987654 - reported symptomatic flaps and possible internal link saturation. Attached BGP RIB samples and traceroutes.

incident-bot: update: page escalation to SEV-OPS due to multi-customer impact.

sara (oncall): handoff note -> I'm staying on for now. Diane, can you draft the initial external status? Keep TTLs stable, don't change DNS unless necessary.

diane (sre): drafting status: 
"We are investigating increased packet loss and intermittent routing instability affecting EU egress via TransitLink. We have failover measures in progress and are routing traffic via backup providers where possible. Root cause under investigation with TransitLink. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes or sooner."

kevin (edge): quick datapoints:
- BGP withdrawals seen for 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/24 between 10:02-10:07 UTC.
- After local-pref change, BGP table shows our prefixes via BackupTransit at 10:14 UTC.

ajay (neteng): still seeing occasional prepends introduced by TransitLink towards our upstream peers, likely they are doing internal mitigation. Also seeing path asymmetry for some AS paths causing RTT spikes.

sara (oncall): notify account owners for top 5 impacted customers (via DM). Diane, can you own the customer comms?

diane (sre): will do. Sending initial note to account owners and posting incident status page.

pagerduty-bot: escalation to seOps done at 2026-03-15T10:18:00Z.

ajay (neteng): TransitLink NOC replied: "We are seeing an internal fabric degradation in region eu-west-1, working on mitigation. We observe BGP churn affecting a subset of customer prefixes." Asked for ETA.

kevin (edge): longer-term action items emerging: add additional upstream diversity in eu-west, increase route-monitoring granularity, and test automated policy failover timing to reduce customer impact window.

sara (oncall): current status summary for post:
- Incident start: 2026-03-15T10:02 UTC
- Root cause: upstream TransitLink internal fabric instability (under investigation)
- Mitigation: rolled traffic to BackupTransit via local-pref failover; partial restoration for most affected services by 10:14 UTC
- Customer impact: 10-40% increased latency and elevated error rates for EU egressed requests during window
- Next steps: Confirm TransitLink fix, validate no residual packetloss, schedule RCA and long-term proofing.

ajay (neteng): still monitoring BGP table and per-prefix telemetry. If TransitLink announces stable routes we can roll traffic back after validation.

diane (sre): drafting post-incident notes and scheduling 1hr RCA with neteng + infra. Will capture timeline, mitigation steps, and customer impact.

sara (oncall): I'm going offline for 20m but will be reachable for major changes. Diane taking effective lead while I'm away.

diane (sre): acknowledged, taking ownership. Adding meeting invite for RCA 11:30 UTC.

kevin (edge): one final check - we increased route-monitoring alert sensitivity and created a temporary dashboard in Console for this incident (latency, per-prefix loss, bgp churn). Link: https://console.internal/incidents/1882001234

incident-bot: Incident channel pinned with initial status. Will send follow-ups every 30m.

ajay (neteng): TransitLink reported partial restoration at 10:40 UTC, BGP churn reduced. We're seeing stable announcements across our prefixes again and loss at probe points <1%.

sara (oncall): confirming service metrics trending back to normal. Marking mitigation as complete; keeping incident open for RCA and follow-up.

diane (sre): customers updated; scheduling RCA. Closing updates in 30m unless regression. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged as "mitigated" in PD at 2026-03-15T10:45:00Z by sara.

end of thread.
